properties.name: The export convention becomes a DesignRule with a check of its own, so reflow2's governance layer can see reflow2's own policy. Anthony 2026-08-11: "reflow2's own rules shouldn't be tracked by hand, but by some governance rules." CORRECTION TO AN EARLIER CLAIM IN THE SAME SESSION: the export rule was NOT unwired — req:the-export-is-serialised-rather-than-socially-enforced is accepted and fully traced through art:check and ver:gate-suite. What was missing is that the policy existed only as a requirement on the SOFTWARE (the gate must detect a severed chain) and never as a convention binding a CONTRIBUTOR, so unverified_enforced_rule — which scans DesignRules — could not see it. `enforced: true` records that breaking it already stops the build, measured twice today; the consequence question was NOT put to Anthony and the rule says so. The new Verification is narrower than ver:gate-suite on purpose: the gate makes several distinct guarantees and one check standing for all of them cannot say which clause still works.
